properties.digitized_from: DataSF Parcels -- Active and Retired (blklot 8705006, real cadastral land-parcel boundary)
properties.digitization_method: REPLACED 2026-09-18 (second correction, after the owner flagged the first fix was still tracing individual building rooftops rather than the site itself): the real Assessor land parcel 8705006 -- the same one this parcel's condo-style unit lots are all mapped against -- gives the full rectangular site boundary (grounds, courtyard and building together), matching the owner's own sketch of what the shape should look like, rather than a tight building-only outline. Still real, official DataSF cadastral data, not a hand trace. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: correction: the parcel 8705006 exists and gives the site boundary, but the statement that condo-style unit lots are mapped against it is not borne out; data/raw/parcels.geojson has exactly one parcel with mapblklot 8705006 (itself). The condo-mapped case among Mission Bay's Avalon buildings is Avalon I (mapblklot 8706011), not this one.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- official DataSF Assessor parcel boundary (blklot 8705006), ~6093 sq m, not a hand trace or plan estimate. 353-383 King St and 260 units per the DataSF Assessor roll (parcel 8705006; AvalonBay's release also gives 260 units, and DataSF Parcels gives the address range 200-298 Berry St); grand opening June 18, 2009 per AvalonBay's own investor-relations press release. This is the whole site/land parcel, not just the building's rooftop -- it includes any courtyard, landscaping or parking within the lot line. Correction 2026-09-29: this is a single Assessor parcel; no per-unit condominium lots map to 8705006 in data/raw/parcels.geojson (the earlier condo-mapping statement was wrong), and why it is not joined via status.csv is not established here.
properties.notes: Third phase of AvalonBay's Mission Bay development (AvalonBay press release, June 18, 2009), managed together with Avalon at Mission Bay North; the DataSF Assessor roll lists this parcel at 353-383 King St.
